negative_prompt: watermark, text signature, logo in corner, artist name, copyright notice, blurry, low resolution, bad anatomy, CGI, 3D digital render, smooth plastic doll skin, hyperrealistic photo of real human, digital illustration, anime, cartoon, glossy toy finish, missing fingers, malformed hands, smiling, cheerful, modern spectacles, futuristic tech, plain white background
reconstruction_priority: tactile stop-motion puppet materials — AI frequently renders hyperrealistic human pores or smooth CGI plastic instead of sculpted polymer clay and bristle fibers
dual-hand spectacle polishing gesture — AI often fuses the cloth rags into the hands or garbles the wire eyeglass frame geometry
expressive facial sculpting with prominent horizontal bristle eyebrows and wide spherical eyes — AI tends to soften or distort the distinctive stop-motion caricature features
macro shallow depth of field with fine forearm micro-hair and frayed fabric textures — AI often blurs or over-smoothes fine craft details
